# Mr. Git

Find your next open source contribution. Mr. Git helps developers discover real GitHub issues that match their skills, experience, and interests.

## Features
- Search GitHub issues by multi-selected skills (up to 10), experience levels, and interests.
- Sort and filter results dynamically by difficulty, star count, and comments.
- Bookmarks list stored in client-side localStorage.
- Copy issue link, view repository, or open issues directly on GitHub.

## API Endpoint
- POST `/api/search`
  - Body: `{"skills": string[], "experience": "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced", "interests": string[]}`
  - Returns curated list of opportunities, matching skills to repositories, with details on issue and match score.
